title: Mexican Chicken Salad
description: Mexican Chicken Salad is a fresh, colorful combination of seasoned chicken, crisp greens, black beans, sweet corn, creamy avocado, and a smoky lime dressing. Finished with crunchy tortilla strips, it's perfect as a light lunch or satisfying main course.

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Sweet corn kernels (fresh or roasted) – 1 cup
Black beans, rinsed and drained – 1 cup
Mixed greens (arugula, romaine, baby spinach) – 4 cups
Red bell pepper, thinly sliced – ½ cup
Shredded Monterey Jack or Cotija cheese – ½ cup (optional for richness)

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: Greek yogurt or Mexican crema – 3 tbsp
Small jalapeño, finely minced – 1 (optional, adjust for spice)

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Crispy tortilla strips or crushed tortilla chips

instruction.title: Step 1 – Cook the Chicken
steps: Season chicken breasts with smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through (internal temp 165°F / 74°C).
Let rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly or shred.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Dressing
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, lime juice, honey, paprika, cumin, and minced jalapeño.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Adjust lime or honey if needed.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Salad
steps: In a large salad bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, corn, red onion, avocado, black beans, bell pepper, and cilantro.
Add sliced or shredded chicken on top.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently until evenly coated.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plate & Garnish
steps: Transfer salad to a serving platter or individual plates.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese, crispy tortilla strips, extra cilantro, and a wedge of lime.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while the greens are crisp and fresh.
Pair with warm tortillas, tortilla chips, or Mexican rice.
Enjoy as a light lunch or a satisfying main course.

chefTips: Roasting the corn adds a subtle smoky sweetness.
Marinating chicken for 30 minutes in a bit of lime juice and olive oil enhances flavor.
Make it ahead: Keep dressing separate until serving to prevent greens from wilting.
Presentation: Use a ring mold to stack salad for a clean, high-end look.
